subject: Insurance
title: Diminished Value Claims
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Diminished Value Claims.

hook.text: Your car was repaired perfectly after an accident.

buildup.text: Buyers pay less for accident-history cars.

discovery.text: In Georgia, you can claim diminished value from the at-fault driver's insurer.

twist.text: Most states allow diminished value claims in theory, but insurers fight them aggressively.

climax.text: Diminished value is the hidden cost of accidents. Even perfectly repaired cars are worth less.

quiz.question: What is a diminished value claim?
options: Compensation for a car's reduced resale value after repairs
